# Dart/Flutter Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: a patterns skill for shipping production Flutter apps without the usual state-management spaghetti. It is organized by concern with copy-paste-ready Dart: null safety done right (avoid the ! operator, prefer ?., ??, and pattern matching), immutable state via sealed classes and Freezed with copyWith, async composition (concurrent Future.wait, safe BuildContext handling after await), widget architecture (extract widgets to classes, never helper methods, propagate const, scope rebuilds), state management with BLoC/Cubit events and Riverpod notifiers plus derived providers, GoRouter navigation with reactive auth guards, Dio networking with interceptors and a one-time token-refresh retry guard, global error capture with ErrorWidget.builder and crash reporting wiring, and testing (BLoC tests, widget tests with ProviderScope overrides, fakes over mocks). By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance, nothing to install; assumes Dart 3 and a working Flutter project; its state-management opinions center on BLoC and Riverpod, so GetX or MobX shops will get less value. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
